title: Getting Ready for the Best Blueberry Harvest in Guasca
metaDescription: At Fresh Pick we are ready to start a new blueberry harvest season in Guasca, grown above 2,800 m.
excerpt: At Fresh Pick we are getting ready to start a new blueberry harvest season, ready to offer a fresh product of excellent quality.
imageAlt: Hands picking fresh blueberries in the Santa Bárbara hamlet, Guasca.

blocks.text: The whole Fresh Pick team is ready to start a new blueberry harvest season. After months of preparation, care and dedication on our farm in the Santa Bárbara hamlet, Guasca, Cundinamarca, the time has come to begin a new stage in our fields above 2,800 m.
Commitment and detail in every berry

Every blueberry we harvest is the result of committed work, done with attention to every detail and with the goal of offering a fresh, firm product of excellent quality with the natural sweetness that characterizes us. We work hand in hand with our growers, collaborators and partners to guarantee that each fruit arrives in the best condition.
A new stage full of opportunities

Our teams are already ready to begin picking, carefully selecting the fruit that meets our rigorous standards and our GLOBALG.A.P., GRASP and ICA certifications. At Fresh Pick we grow with spring and rainwater irrigation and 100% natural pollination with our 7 beehives, to proudly bring the best of our fields to all our customers.

author: Fresh Pick Team
